method: Separate read-only semantic examination of the exact sources, final procedures and explicit finite states. Fresh independent checker imports no author script. This is one director static review, not an independent human or runtime execution.

resolvedDefects.correction: Rebuilt only affected Sphere traces using actual paid self Levitate, whole bodies strictly inside inner boundary aboveground, real outside platform, and actual Shoves. No invented interior floor or flying Speed.

resolvedDefects.finding: Extra-actor regular ends overlapped later initiative starts
resolvedDefects.correction: Recorded each actual next ordered slot; independent check requires end strictly before it. Corrected affected Slow END saves, Blood Sacrifice endpoint and Falling marker. No spell pulse creates actor turns.

resolvedDefects.finding: Close-hostile ranged disadvantage and burst point were underspecified
resolvedDefects.correction: Recorded actual two-die disadvantage without stacked dice; retained outcomes. Ice Knife actual captured impact near target face geometrically includes declared5ft burst recipients; critical applies only piercing.

resolvedDefects.finding: Reflection provenance could be confused with pure transfer
resolvedDefects.correction: Reflected damage is a new root with reflector-as-dealer and its own Null evaluation; post-defense sharing has one original root and bypasses second mitigation/reflection. Missing positive Null activation is held.

resolvedDefects.finding: Historical Rebind and current selection labels differed
resolvedDefects.correction: Bound exact accepted Magic7 model/receipt and kept strict typed-removal scope. CorrectedQ12/Q20 labels to match actual options; all disposition/procedure copies derive from one final text.

resolvedDefects.finding: Predicate-only boundary/condition rows were insufficient acceptance evidence
resolvedDefects.correction: Retained exact positive-evidence blockers; no held row is counted as demonstrating a campaign fact or a required actual source attempt.

remainingBlockers.title: Required positive condition-track coverage incomplete
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: The generic current Exhausted/Expedition/poison/disease distinctions are bound and the procedure states them, but no exact generating producer/acquisition and complete prior track history is instantiated for these branches. This is a coverage blocker, not a claim that no producer exists anywhere.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: Bind actual producer and accessible actor or exact prior source-qualified state; demonstrate real retained levels/maximumHP/currentHP/expiry and symptom suppression/resumption separately from expedition Strain and disease cure. Do not invent a poison, disease or campaign exposure.

remainingBlockers.title: Positive reflector Null activation premise missing
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: Current RootNull rules distinguish original transfer from newly reflected roots. The actual acquired Null-enabling source and legal enabling state for the reflector are not supplied in this positive fixture.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: Bind the exact authorized enabling source, actual acquired actor and state. Demonstrate original flag preserved on transfers and separately evaluated reflector flag on the new reflection root, through resulting life-state handling.

remainingBlockers.title: Quantified environmental selected-element producer absent
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: The noncreature no-reflection-target rule is selected, but no actual quantified elemental hazard with original source/geometry/timing is supplied. Falling cannot be renamed cold or fire.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: Supply the exact reviewed hazard and actual matter/geometry/timing/input values; demonstrate selected-type immunity with no invented responsible creature or reflected recipient.

remainingBlockers.title: Positive companion attribution lacks full content
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: A companion dealer must remain distinct from its controller. A feature name alone supplies neither a complete whole-body profile nor a legal attack/position/custody history for this positive branch.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: Bind the exact accessible companion grant and complete required body/equipment/attack content; retain attached phase and command history and resolve reflection against the actual dealer, never an invented controller substitute.

remainingBlockers.title: Positive occupied reversion premise missing
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: The conservative energy anatomy keeps the same collision geometry and grants no wall passage/shrinking. No separately legal intervening geometry/body change has been supplied that makes the original body return occupied. Unsupported reversion is demonstrated separately.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: Bind a real accessible intervening source and actual geometry change; demonstrate the scoped root-body placement/pending branch with no crush, discretionary relocation, permanent invulnerability or invented wall passage.

remainingBlockers.title: Positive aging-state evidence incomplete
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: The ordinary clock and Haste/Slow traces are complete, but no actual age/birth-calendar record or accessible aging producer is instantiated in the full-state cases. A prevention sentence alone is not positive aging evidence.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: Bind the exact applicable age/calendar or reviewed aging producer and actual recipient facts, then record before/after aging state while ordinary world, expiry and resource clocks continue. Do not infer birth date, retroactive age reversal or a new cosmological clock.

remainingBlockers.title: Time Stop remains pending with no operational pointer
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: The exact current index still lacks a complete accepted Time Stop procedure. A generic immunity flag is not positive evidence of independent chronology for immune subjects.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: After an exact accepted Time Stop procedure is available, bind each actual native placement/access/actor and demonstrate the joint exclusion, simultaneous immune subjects, ordinary opportunity accounting and unchanged external clocks. Do not invent turns.

remainingBlockers.title: Required actual planar attempt not demonstrated
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: Teleport is positively demonstrated with a legal commitment and paid failure. The planar row is only a boundary predicate; it supplies no real acquired planar activation or required actual paired-site/plane facts.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: Bind an already accepted exact planar source with legal accessible actor and its actual paired destination/topology prerequisites, then demonstrate the paid blocked attempt and retained source clocks. Preserve cosmology/physical holds where those facts are unavailable.

remainingBlockers.title: Required actual cross-boundary control attempt not demonstrated
remainingBlockers.missingEvidence: The control-message row is only the selected partition predicate. No actual acquired channel, commanded body, pending job and message lifecycle is demonstrated in that row.
remainingBlockers.minimalCorrection: Bind the exact current accepted control source and legal actor/body/job; demonstrate issue, attempted transmission, failure/expiry and unchanged costs/command budgets. Existing concentration bookkeeping alone is not positive command transmission.

scope: Acceptance is limited to each exact procedure/case model and retained qualifications. A data-integrity pass never overrides a required missing branch. No canonical index/catalog/queue/handoff write.
